# Textbook Outline

This textbook bridges the gap between introductory calculus and advanced undergraduate mathematics, serving as a comprehensive reference and learning guide. 

## Part I: Single Variable Calculus
- [Chapter 1: Limits and Continuity](01-limits.qmd)
- [Chapter 2: Derivatives and Rates of Change](02-derivatives.qmd)
- [Chapter 3: Integration and the Fundamental Theorem](03-integrals.qmd)
- **Chapter 4:** Applications of Integration (Area, Volume, Work)
- **Chapter 5:** Sequences, Series, and Convergence Tests
- **Chapter 6:** Power Series and Taylor Series

## Part II: Multivariable Calculus
- **Chapter 7:** Vectors and the Geometry of Space
- **Chapter 8:** Vector-Valued Functions and Motion in Space
- **Chapter 9:** Partial Derivatives and the Gradient
- **Chapter 10:** Multiple Integrals (Double and Triple)
- **Chapter 11:** Vector Calculus (Line Integrals, Surface Integrals)
- **Chapter 12:** Green's, Stokes', and the Divergence Theorem

## Part III: Linear Algebra
- **Chapter 13:** Systems of Linear Equations and Matrices
- **Chapter 14:** Matrix Operations and Inverses
- **Chapter 15:** Determinants
- **Chapter 16:** Vector Spaces and Subspaces
- **Chapter 17:** Linear Transformations
- **Chapter 18:** Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors, and Diagonalization
- **Chapter 19:** Inner Product Spaces and Orthogonality

## Part IV: Differential Equations
- **Chapter 20:** First-Order Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs)
- **Chapter 21:** Second-Order Linear ODEs
- **Chapter 22:** Systems of First-Order Linear Equations
- **Chapter 23:** The Laplace Transform
- **Chapter 24:** Introduction to Partial Differential Equations (PDEs)
- **Chapter 25:** Fourier Series and Boundary Value Problems

## Part V: Real Analysis
- **Chapter 26:** The Real Number System and Supremum Axiom
- **Chapter 27:** Topology of the Real Line (Open/Closed Sets, Compactness)
- **Chapter 28:** Rigorous Limits and Continuity ($\epsilon-\delta$)
- **Chapter 29:** Sequences of Functions and Uniform Convergence
- **Chapter 30:** Introduction to Measure Theory and Lebesgue Integration

## Part VI: Complex Analysis
- **Chapter 31:** The Complex Plane and Complex Algebra
- **Chapter 32:** Analytic Functions and the Cauchy-Riemann Equations
- **Chapter 33:** Complex Integration and Cauchy's Theorem
- **Chapter 34:** Taylor and Laurent Series
- **Chapter 35:** The Residue Theorem and Contour Integration
- **Chapter 36:** Conformal Mappings and Applications
